name: JoAi: Query Metrics

description.en: Read normalized metrics for an explicit source, resource, and period. Providers: Cloudflare (web traffic) and Google Search Console (search clicks/impressions).
description.de: Lies normalisierte Metriken für eine explizite Quelle, Ressource und einen Zeitraum. Provider: Cloudflare (Webtraffic) und Google Search Console (Suchklicks/Impressionen).
description.es: Consulta métricas normalizadas para una fuente, un recurso y un período explícitos. Proveedores: Cloudflare (tráfico web) y Google Search Console (clics/impresiones de búsqueda).
description.fr: Consulte des métriques normalisées pour une source, une ressource et une période explicites. Fournisseurs : Cloudflare (trafic web) et Google Search Console (clics/impressions de recherche).
description.ro: Citește metrici normalizate pentru o sursă, o resursă și o perioadă explicite. Furnizori: Cloudflare (trafic web) și Google Search Console (clicuri/impresii de căutare).
description.it: Leggi metriche normalizzate per una fonte, una risorsa e un periodo espliciti. Provider: Cloudflare (traffico web) e Google Search Console (clic/impressioni di ricerca).

bot: Use this to obtain source-backed facts before creating a client update. For Cloudflare, report unique visitors and page views exactly as returned. For google_search_console, report search.clicks and search.impressions — these are Search Console metrics, not site analytics visitors. Resource for Cloudflare is the 32-char zone tag; for Google Search Console use sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/.

description.en: Provider resource id. Cloudflare: 32-char zone tag. Google Search Console: sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/.
description.de: Ressourcenkennung. Cloudflare: 32-stelliger Zone-Tag. Google Search Console: sc-domain:example.com oder https://example.com/.
